hana (product): quick thread  sales/legal asked for an eDiscovery preview API + clear guarantees for legal-hold exports. propose alternative retention tiers to reduce cost pressure: Search=14d, Short=90d, Cold=5y. also propose a preview API that returns sample results within 6h for a targeted timeframe.

nave (eng): ok on tiers. preview API design: query time-range -> return metadata sample (paths + sha256) and a signed manifest draft. full export chunking: parallel workers produce shard archives + merkle_root for tamper-evidence. example manifest entry: `{"path":"s3://...","sha256":"...","shard":"part-0001.gz"}`. We'll expose `export.preview_id` so legal can reference.

sophia (security): security asks: require signed merkle_root in manifest and signing_key_fingerprint. BYOK: include `customer_keystore_id` and `kms_key_version`. If customer opts out of escrow, they must provide a verification key for preview+export signatures. Acceptance: security must validate merkle root + signatures for 3 sample customers during canary (one BYOK with verification key, one BYOK no-escrow, one standard).

ravi (legal): timeline expectations: preview within 6h (targeted timeframe), full scoped export within 7 days (we can commit to faster than 10d). need API to pin records indefinitely and an audit trail: requester_email, legal_hold_id, custody_ticket, reason_code. previews must be discoverable without full download. also require a human-readable evidence summary in manifest.

marta (ops): ops concerns: preview queries can be heavy if run ad-hoc. plan: precompute lightweight indexes for legal-hold queries and rate-limit preview jobs. export backpressure: per-tenant queue + `exports.priority` and `exports.max_concurrent_shards`. Canary: 6 tenants for 48h -> 30% traffic for 4 days -> full. estimate storage/meta delta +6%.

dave (eng): migration note: no blanket backfill. legacy archives get generated on-demand; preview API will run best-effort scans for legacy data. new events emit `retention_tier` and `legal_hold_id` when pinned. add feature-flag `edisco.preview_v1`.

sophia (security): add acceptance check: verifier can fetch manifest, recompute merkle root from shards, and validate signature within 24h. log signing_audit_id in export metadata.

hana (product): decisions by Fri EOD: (1) adopt tiers (14/90/5y), (2) preview SLA 6h + export SLA 7d, (3) schema fields (`legal_hold_id`, `reason_code`, `requester_email`, `retention_tier`, `merkle_root`, `signing_key_fingerprint`), (4) canary cadence. I'll draft a short RFC and attach runbooks.

ci-bot: ticket INF-5780 created, will add canary window and a nightly smoke test for preview API.

hana (product): thanks  will share RFC link and acceptance checklist. please add migration/runbook notes inline.
